ayahOccurrences.text: فَإِمَّا تَثْقَفَنَّهُمْ فِى ٱلْحَرْبِ فَشَرِّدْ بِهِم مَّنْ خَلْفَهُمْ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَذَّكَّرُونَ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: فَإِمَّا تَثْقَفَنَّهُمْ فِى ٱلْحَرْبِ فَشَرِّدْ بِهِم مَّنْ خَلْفَهُمْ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَذَّكَّرُونَ

lexSnapshot.wordGrammar: 2nd person masculine singular (form II) imperative verb
lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: فَشَرِّدْ is in the derivative form: شَرِّد
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ش/ر/د   sh–r–d to bolt, to break loose; to roam, to go astray; to disperse, to scatter; to be absent‐minded. Of this root, only شَرِّد sharrid occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
شَرِّد sharrid [imper. of v. II] scatter, disperse, put to flight, frighten away *

(8:57) فَإِمَّا تَثْقَفَنَّهُمْ فِى الْحَرْبِ فَشَرِّدْ بِهِمْ مَنْ خَلْفَهُمْ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَذَّكَّرُونَ if you gain mastery over them in battle, use them to frighten those who [later] follow them, so that they may take heed.
